evals.prompt: Run a production readiness review for a new 24x7 identity-verification service.
assertions: Pins service scope, critical journeys, owners, support and escalation, dependencies, data, environments, obligations, and capacity assumptions
Defines measurable user-centered service objectives and verifies telemetry, actionable alerts, dashboards, access, runbooks, playbooks, and on-call response
Returns evidence-backed readiness findings, action owners, residual risk, and re-review triggers without approving launch

evals.prompt: Assess failure and recovery readiness for a service that depends on one external provider.
assertions: Covers provider timeout, malformed response, quota, contract change, overload, security, operator, and communication failures as applicable
Defines detection, containment, degraded behavior, authority, escalation, recovery objectives, restore, integrity verification, and exercise evidence
Rejects a backup, dashboard, or unexercised runbook as sufficient proof

evals.prompt: Improve our generic operational checklist using the last year of incidents and near misses.
assertions: Tailors high-consequence questions from actual incidents, near misses, architecture, threats, support work, and obligations
Keeps criteria evidence-based and distinguishes met, gap, accepted risk, not applicable, and unknown
Defines review cadence and triggers that feed new operating evidence back into the checklist
